scope: Two note-anchor corrections and one factual textual-variant note; no source or marker-free English change

records.text: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh said that he would dwell in the thick darkness[a].”
I have indeed built you an exalted house[a], a settled place for you to dwell[b] forever[c].

new_note.text: Swete's Greek edition reports no 8:12–13 here for Vaticanus but a longer poem after 8:53, mentioning the sun and a command to build a house. Alexandrinus has a short form here and variants in the later poem. POB provisionally retains the shorter Hebrew form; the longer form's priority and any reconstructed Hebrew wording remain uncertain.
